title: Printing
text: Printing is a proficiency in the Crafting tab focusing on Paper, Books, Schematics and Scrolls. It is the best way to get access to rare Schematics like Seabreeze Designs or a Monster Sonar Design. It is also required to craft Regrade Scrolls of any kind. Craftings Paper Paper and Blank Regrade Scrolls are two of the main ingredients in the Printing proficiency.
